_readme: The goddess who brought Sam over (js/logic/goddess.js, docs/GODDESS.md). Numbers are in balance.json → goddess.
Placeholders: {goddess} her name, {sam}, {house}, {partner} (first name), {past} (Sam's past life, lowercase), {lady} (a lady's first name), {n}, {names}, {cycle}, {skill}.
Any text field may be a list: one entry is picked at random.
npc: her look for image prompts (same fields as a named lady's design). image blocks: {comp, setting, sam, pov} like story images (scenes.json).
intro: cycle 1, shown before the Vane welcome. pasts[k].intro = her remark on Sam's first past life; pasts[k].again = when he remembers it in New Game+.
houses[id]: her remark when the house becomes Sam's (intro, rebirth, bought mid-cycle from cycle 2 on). partners[key].hand = how she had a hand in Sam meeting her; .comment = her remark about her.

rebirth: at every New Game+ before the binding. fast/steady/slow = how quickly he paid (weeks vs the plan). lovers/alone = lovers carried or none. jealous.low/mid/high by her jealousy. bound.low/mid/high = after the binding, by her divinity.
teases: her scenes before the binding, in order; each only from minCycle. choices: love, jealousy (added), energy (Sam's), res. She never lets Sam finish: that would bind her.
remarks.low/mid/high: short jealous remarks (by jealousy) as weekly events; remarkChoices are their default answers.

binding: the first rebirth after a lady has lived a fully reincarnated life; she confesses it was never a whim. focus: her weekly guidance options (report lines; indulge has feminine/futa variants, chosen by her form setting). claim: what she does when jealousy wins. night: Sam's action on her tab (image, open by divinity low/mid/high, then inside / outside / unhappy lists by how the night ended; {act} = the service label, lowercase). ending.stay/leave: full divinity again.

services: her own lines per service id (ids as in services.json; _default is the fallback). Three contexts: sam = a night with Sam (she is the woman doing/receiving; _give = she gives, _get = she receives); feminine = she with a lady in her female form (report line; the id is the lady's point of view, e.g. oral_give = the lady pleases her; no tier 3 entries, they are not used); futa = same with a lady in her futa form. {lady} is the lady's first name. Lists: one is picked at random.
name: Seliora
title: the Lamplighter
tabBlurb: Goddess of crossings and kept flames, currently bound to a former {past}, glowing a little less than she used to and not entirely sorry about it.

design.eyes: gold, with a thin ring of light around each iris
design.skin: warm bronze that glows faintly from within, like a lantern
design.features: faint gold markings along her collarbones and hips that brighten with her mood, a small ember-flame floating near her shoulder

npc.customOutfit: a sheer crimson-and-gold wrap dress held by thin gold chains, barefoot

intro.title: Before the truck stops ringing

image.comp: a radiant goddess with a glowing bronze skin and a small ember-flame at her shoulder, sitting in a dark void lit by hundreds of hanging paper lanterns, looking down with an amused smile, one hand extended
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

intro.open:
The horn is still ringing when the dark fills up with lanterns. Hundreds of them, hanging from nothing.

A woman sits among them as if on a swing, barefoot, a little ember-flame drifting lazily around her shoulder. Her skin glows from within like a lantern, gold markings brightening at her collarbones and hips as she looks Sam over, slowly, head to toe, like someone deciding what to unwrap first.

"Sam Takahashi. Thirty-one years of being nice to people and nobody ever once being nice back on purpose." She tilts her head. "I'm {goddess}. I light the way across, for the ones I pick. I picked you. On a whim, mostly. Don't read into it." She smiles like a woman who is reading into it a great deal.
intro.close:
"There's a debt. There's always a debt, it keeps you honest. Pay it, and if you're still interesting, I'll bring you back and we'll do it again." She trails one fingertip down his chest, leans close enough that her warmth fills the dark, and doesn't kiss him. "I'll be watching. Everything. Give me something worth watching."

The lanterns go out, one by one.

salaryman.intro: "Eight years of spreadsheets. You reconciled other people's money for a living and nobody ever reconciled you." {goddess} sounds almost fond. "It'll come in handy. Debts are just ledgers that bite."
salaryman.again: "Ah, the ledgers again." She sounds delighted. "Now you've got two lives' worth of columns. Try not to get lost in the margins."

bartender.intro: "A part-time bartender, hm." {goddess} turns an imaginary glass in her fingers. "Pouring drinks and listening to strangers. You were practicing for this and didn't even know."
bartender.again: "You remember the bar, too?" She grins. "Good. Charm like that shouldn't go to waste. Pour me one sometime."

gym.intro: "You went to the gym three times a week and never once looked at yourself in the mirror." {goddess} pokes his arm. "Thin, and sturdy underneath. I like a surprise."
gym.again: "The gym rat, back again." She squeezes his bicep and pretends to be unimpressed. "Still thin. Still strong. Still mine to watch."

otaku.intro: "Don't look so smug. I know you've read this story a hundred times." {goddess} lies back on the lanterns. "Truck, goddess, new world. You even know to ask about the stats. It's adorable. Don't skip my lines."
otaku.again: "Oh good, you remember being a genre expert." She laughs. "Now you know exactly how many clichés you're living in. I'm one of them, and I'm quite pleased with myself."

cook.intro: "Staff meals and midnight noodles for coworkers who never said thank you." {goddess} sniffs the air as if she can smell them. "I did. Feed people here and see what happens."
cook.again: "Your cooking again!" She is already hovering over an invisible pot. "I'll allow that one. Save me a bowl, would you?"

massage.intro: "Good hands and no idea what to do with them." {goddess} takes one of them and turns it over, studying it. "A massage therapist. I'll be keeping an eye on those."
massage.again: "The hands, too." She holds out her shoulder with a martyred sigh. "For old time's sake. Purely professional."

tutor.intro: "Six years of cram school, drilling teenagers for exams they'd forget." {goddess} tilts her head. "A teacher who never got a thank-you. Teach this house something, and I'll be thanking you myself."
tutor.again: "Teacher again." She folds her hands behind her back, mock-prim. "Tell me, professor, do I get extra credit for supervising you?"

houses.lantern: "The Gilded Lantern." {goddess} sounds innocent. "I may have nudged the old owner's luck. Mira's already decided you're hers to mother, so mind your manners. Or don't."
houses.castle: "Castle Rosenhal. Noble Hill." {goddess} looks very pleased. "I stood on those ramparts when the count still had a mind. Cecile will fold you into shape. I wouldn't mind watching it."
houses.onsen: {goddess} lets a long, contented sigh drift through the steam. "A hot spring. I had no ulterior motive, none at all. Tsubaki sings dreadfully, you'll love it."
houses.hollow: "Hollowmere Manor, dirt cheap, because it's haunted." {goddess} smiles into her lantern. "I know Vesper. We've shared a candle or two. Be nice to her, she's been waiting three centuries for you."
houses.tankard: "The Rusty Tankard! Noisy, cheap and crowded." {goddess} grins. "Hilde lost a brewery to a giant, and she still owes me a pint. Collect it for me, would you?"
houses.pavilion: "The Moonlit Pavilion." {goddess} swirls a lantern like a lily on a pond. "Sylphine will make you clap, I promise. Don't let her out-dazzle me."
houses.veil: "The Crimson Veil. Underdistrict." {goddess} looks entirely too innocent. "Zaria and I go way back. She keeps a ledger of favors, and I may be in it. Play nice with the demon, Sam."
houses.wayfarer: "Every road meets at the Wayfarer's Rest." {goddess} sounds smug. "Including yours. Bettina reads boots and hats, but she doesn't know about me. Yet."
houses.skyhook: "The Skyhook, bolted to a cliff." {goddess} laughs and shades her eyes. "I borrowed Rinna's wreck for a night once. She tells tall tales, but this one is true."
houses.pearl: "The Pearl Grotto." For once {goddess} pauses before she answers. "Maris was old when I was young. Nobody knows who built it. I may know, but I won't say. Go on, relax."

kaede.hand: Seliora flicked a goblin ambush onto the road a few steps in front of a certain fox-eared scout, and made sure Sam would stumble in at exactly the wrong, right moment. A favor had to start somewhere, after all.
kaede.comment: "The scout who keeps tallies?" {goddess} wrinkles her nose. "She's counting favors. I'm counting her."

yui.hand: Sam never saw the accountant two desks over cross the street with him. {goddess} did, and she nudged Yui's fall a week early so she could arrive first and find her feet.
yui.comment: "Yui, from the office." {goddess} sounds odd. "I let her come. She's tidy, and she knows you in ways I can't. That last part is annoying."

nerys.hand: The summoning circle was Nerys's own; the hole in the sky above it was {goddess}'s. Seliora aimed Sam's fall at the exact spot, and she's smug that the contract clause she never saw trigger did so.
nerys.comment: "A contract devil, hm." {goddess} laughs. "She's read the fine print. I wrote the clause she missed. Don't tell her."

elowen.hand: Elowen didn't just happen to be on that stretch of road. {goddess} left a fever on the wind, dropped Sam where a healer would find him, and let two lonely people do the rest.
elowen.comment: "The healer. Three days she nursed you." {goddess} sniffs. "I only helped a little. And I'm entirely not jealous of her cool hands on your forehead."

adelheid.hand: The Order's foretelling of a hero was no accident: {goddess} whispered it into a vision, years early. She only left out the hoodie, and that, she admits, is her favorite part.
adelheid.comment: "The knight." {goddess} bursts out laughing. "I promised her a hero. She got you. I'm not sorry. Her oath is delightful. Be gentle with it."

natsuki.hand: Natsuki's shortcut through the alley was no shortcut: {goddess} opened a door three years early, and left it ajar with a lantern on the far side so the girl would last until Sam came.
natsuki.comment: "The sword-girl who punched you." {goddess} smirks. "Good. Someone should. She's very loyal, and I've started watching for her fists."

kanako.hand: {goddess} put Kanako at the right drink stall in the right town, and left a particular recipe on her tongue. Some people deserve to be found by a neighbor who knows how they take their coffee.
kanako.comment: "Kanako. Sammy." {goddess} mimics the voice and wrinkles her nose. "A nickname, from a woman who knows what you eat for breakfast. I'm taking notes."

akari.hand: Akari wasn't meant to cross that street. {goddess} lengthened the walk signal by one second, which is how a spare umbrella and an old crush ended up in the same world as Sam.
akari.comment: "Kenta's little sister." {goddess} looks at her nails. "Young, and brave. I let her come because she asked. That's a rule I don't have, and I'm already regretting it."

marisol.hand: {goddess} steered the old owner out of the picture, politely, then steered a tired stranger to the deed. She wanted the Lantern to have someone who'd listen to its books.
marisol.comment: "The accountant's daughter." {goddess} nods slowly. "She forgave nobody and taught you everything. I hate how much I like her."

lara.hand: A rumor of a hoodied stranger in Hollowmere drifted to Lara on a very particular wind. {goddess} sent it. She doesn't like it when the ones who are left behind stay that way.
lara.comment: "Lara, the orphanage girl." {goddess} says it softly, for once. "She's been left too often. Don't be one more. I mean it."

emily.hand: Emily woke in her character's body because {goddess} heard a lonely wolf-girl typing into the night and decided the story was worth a real ending. The rumor that led her to Sam was a bonus.
emily.comment: "The wolf-girl. Shadowkin." {goddess} laughs. "Six years of campaigns, and you never once noticed. I did. I'm very proud of myself."

lirael.hand: The postbox in the alley was old, enchanted and not very quiet. {goddess} stirred it ten years ago, once, so two lonely teenagers could find each other. She's been waiting for the ownership notice ever since.
lirael.comment: "Lirael, the letter girl." {goddess} smiles. "Ten years of letters, and you never thought to wonder who carried them. I did. It was a pleasure."

ella.hand: {goddess} could have saved Ella from the crosswalk. She didn't. Her rival was the only person who'd pushed Sam his whole life, and a world without rankings seemed wrong for either of them.
ella.comment: "Ella, the runner-up." {goddess} smiles thinly. "She kept all your sheets in a drawer. I read them. We both know exactly what that means."

ione.hand: {goddess} reached three centuries forward, picked one particular android off a charging dock and pointed her backwards. Some stories need their reader to meet the author. She will not say more.
ione.comment: "The android with the diary." {goddess} pauses. "She's read how it ends. I haven't. If she tells you, don't tell me. ...Tell me."

anael.hand: Sam is the unsent soul the Order is hunting, because {goddess} never sent him: she plucked him out of line. The Lantern Stone burned out of sheer surprise. Anael just happens to be the one who found it.
anael.comment: "An angel, writing reports." {goddess} laughs. "About me, in a roundabout way. Her handwriting's gotten warmer. I'm not jealous, I'm a professional."

rebirth.title: Again, {sam}?

image.comp: a radiant goddess with glowing bronze skin and a small ember-flame at her shoulder, lounging on a crescent of lantern-light, chin on her hand, smiling down, dress slipping off one shoulder
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

open:
The lanterns again. {goddess} is lying on her stomach across a crescent of light, chin in her hands, feet kicking idly, her dress slipping off one shoulder and no effort made to fix it.

"Debt paid. Look at you." She looks him over, unhurried. "Come here and let me see what the work did to you."

Darkness, then the warm smell of candle smoke. {goddess} is waiting, sitting on nothing, legs crossed, the little ember-flame circling her shoulder like a pet. "There he is. My favorite investment." She crooks a finger.

"Welcome back." {goddess} doesn't look up from the lantern she's turning in her hands. Inside it, very small, is the house he just left. "You did it again. I watched all of it. All of it, {sam}. You have no idea how much I enjoyed some of those nights."
fast: "That was quick. Show-off." She sounds pleased anyway. "I do like a man who gets the job done."
"Paid early. Marguerite nearly smiled, did you see? I had money on it. Now you owe me a kiss."
steady: "Right on schedule. Reliable. It's a good look on you." Her eyes drift down and back up. "Mostly."
"Not fast, not slow. You're very consistent, {sam}. I like a man with stamina."
slow: "That went right down to the wire. I had to watch through my fingers." She doesn't say which fingers she was using.
"You cut that close. Do you know how boring the afterlife paperwork is? Don't make me do it. I'd rather be doing you." She doesn't even pretend to have misspoken.
lovers: "And you're taking {names} with you." A pause that lasts slightly too long. "Of course you are. I hope they appreciate what I've been doing to keep you in such good shape."
"{names}. Again." She counts on her fingers and stops before she runs out. "Sweet. Do tell me everything later."
alone: "Nobody coming along this time? Hm." She looks like she wants to be disappointed for you and can't quite manage it. "More of you for me, then."

low: "Go on, then. Have fun. Tell me about it after."
"Enjoy yourself." A smile. "I will be, vicariously."
mid: "There are a lot of them now, {sam}." She says it lightly. She's looking at the lanterns, not at him.
"You know they don't remember me? Only you do. I find that very fair. Mostly."
high: She catches his chin before he goes and holds it, thumb against his lip. "Every life, more of them. I brought you here. Remember that."
"I counted them. I didn't mean to. I count everything I'm not allowed to have." Her hand slides down his chest, and lingers.

close: She kisses two fingers and presses them to his forehead, then, after a thought, to his mouth. The lanterns go out.
"Off you go." She flicks his nose, then smooths a hand down his front like she's checking the goods. The dark folds up like paper.
"Don't keep me waiting." She almost sounds like she means something by it. Then the lanterns go out.

low: This time there are no lanterns. {goddess} is just there when he wakes, warm against his side, mortal-tired, one leg thrown over his. "Again," she mumbles into his neck. "I'm coming too. Obviously."
mid: {goddess} wakes him by pressing close, glowing brighter than last time, the little ember-flame bobbing over her shoulder. "Another life. I'm getting some of it back, you know. Mostly thanks to you. Don't let it go to your head." She kisses him to make sure it does.
high: {goddess} is already up, glowing faintly, watching him sleep with her chin on her hand. "Nearly whole again," she says when he opens his eyes, and slides closer. She doesn't say what happens then.

teases.title: A visitor in the night

image.comp: a goddess with glowing bronze skin and gold markings sitting on the edge of a man's bed at night, dress slipping, leaning in for a kiss, candle-light around her

teases.text:
Sam wakes because the room is warm. {goddess} is sitting on the edge of his bed, glowing softly, the ember-flame drifting over her shoulder and every candle in the room lit without a match. Her dress has slipped, and she hasn't noticed. Or she has.

"I said I'd be watching. I didn't say I'd only watch." She leans down and kisses him, slow and very thorough, one hand sliding under the blanket to rest warm and proprietary on his stomach, and then she's gone, and the room is just a room.

choices.label: Kiss her back
choices.res: He catches the last of it. Somewhere, very far away, someone laughs, pleased.

teases.title: In the mirror
teases.text:
Shaving, Sam looks up and {goddess} is in the mirror behind him, chin on his shoulder, though nothing touches his shoulder. Her reflection is not wearing much.

"You're very popular here." She watches him in the glass, eyes dropping to the towel and back up. "I picked well. I'm only slightly annoyed about it. Watching you shave is the best part of my morning."

choices.label: "You could come out of the mirror."
choices.res: "Could I?" Her reflection kisses his reflection's neck. His actual neck gets goosebumps. Then the mirror is just a mirror.

choices.label: "Jealous?"
choices.res: "Of whom? I'm a goddess." The mirror fogs over, which is not an answer.

teases.title: Hot water

image.comp: a goddess with glowing bronze skin sitting behind a man in a steaming bath, her arms around his shoulders, gold markings glowing under the water, teasing smile
image.setting: a steaming wooden bath at night, lanterns

teases.text:
The bath is already hot when Sam gets in, and already occupied. {goddess} settles in behind him, wraps both arms around his chest and hooks her chin over his shoulder, warm and bare against his back. Her hands wander. They know exactly where they're going and exactly when to stop.

"Breathe," she murmurs. "That's all you get tonight. Don't look so disappointed. I like it."

choices.label: Lean back into her
choices.res: She hums against his ear and keeps him right there, on the edge, until the water cools. He comes out of it oddly rested and extremely frustrated.

choices.label: Turn around
choices.res: She's gone before he finishes turning. The water ripples where she was, smug.

teases.title: Overtime
teases.text:
Sam is doing the books. {goddess} is sitting on the books. Specifically on the open ledger, legs crossed, reading his numbers upside down.

"You undercharge." She uncrosses her legs, slowly, and watches him lose his place. "I don't."

choices.label: "What do you charge?"
choices.res: She leans forward until her nose touches his. "More than you can pay. Ask again in a few lives." When she's gone the ledger is balanced, which is somehow worse.

choices.label: Move her off the ledger
choices.res: She lets him lift her. She weighs nothing at all, and she knows exactly what that does to him.

teases.title: A dream that isn't

image.comp: a goddess with glowing bronze skin straddling a man's lap on a crescent of light, gold markings blazing, her hands on his chest, holding back
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

teases.text:
Sam falls asleep and lands somewhere among the lanterns, with {goddess} in his lap. She takes her time. She takes a great deal of it, hands roaming his chest and shoulders as though she owns them. Every time he gets close she stops, waits, smiles, and starts again.

"You want to know why," she says, eventually, against his mouth. "Not yet."

choices.label: "Then when?"
choices.res: "When it means something." She says it like a joke. It doesn't sound like one. He wakes up gasping, alone, and very awake.

choices.label: Let her play
choices.res: She plays. He wakes up rested, which is unfair, and wanting, which is worse.

teases.title: Counting
teases.text:
{goddess} is waiting in Sam's room with her arms folded, every candle in the room burning an offended, sulky orange.

"{n}. {n} of them." She doesn't say of what. "Tonight you're mine. Don't argue, I'm a goddess."

She pulls him down onto the bed and keeps him there all night: close, closer, never all the way, her hands and mouth making very sure he won't forget whose bed this is. She never once lets him finish.

choices.label: "You could just stay."
choices.res: She goes very still. "No," she says. "I couldn't." Then, quieter, into his shoulder: "It wasn't a whim, you know. Forget I said that." She stays until dawn anyway.

choices.label: Tell her she's the only goddess
choices.res: "That's a technicality," she says, pleased, and bites his ear.

teases.title: Not yet

image.comp: a goddess with glowing bronze skin on top of a man in bed at night, gold markings blazing, one hand pressed to his chest to hold him still, intense look

teases.text:
This time she doesn't stop at the edge. She takes him in, slow, eyes closed, gold markings blazing along her hips, and for a moment the whole room is lantern-light, every flame bowing toward them.

Then her hand is flat on his chest. "Stop. Stay. Don't." Her voice isn't steady. "If you finish in me I'm yours. Not as a figure of speech. And I've wanted you for far longer than you know." She stays exactly like that, holding them both on the edge, until she can let go of him without either of them breaking.

choices.label: Hold still for her
choices.res: He does. It is the hardest thing he has ever done. Afterwards she lies on his chest for a long time and doesn't disappear.

choices.label: "Would that be so bad?"
choices.res: "For a goddess? Catastrophic." She kisses him. "Ask me again later."

teases.title: Edges
teases.text:
{goddess} visits more often now and leaves later. She takes him all the way in and stops, every time, at the very last moment, with a sound like it costs her more than it costs him.

"You know what I'd lose." Her forehead against his. "Everything I am. And I'd be yours. I watched you for years before the truck, you know. Years. I don't even know which of those scares me more."

choices.label: "I'd give it back."
choices.res: She laughs, shakily. "You'd try. You're very stubborn." She doesn't say no.

choices.label: Kiss her until she stops thinking
choices.res: It works for a while. At dawn she's still there, which is new.

teases.title: What if
teases.text:
{goddess} sits on the windowsill, glowing faintly, the ember-flame dozing against her neck, looking at the house.

"One of them has done it all now, you know. Lived and lived again, as far as a life can carry." She doesn't look at him. "You fed that stray cat every morning for two years and nobody ever saw. I saw. It wasn't a whim, Sam. It never was." She finally turns. "When you bring her back next time, I'm coming too. I don't think I can watch from the lanterns anymore."

choices.label: "Then come."
choices.res: "Next time," she says. "Finish what you started." Then she's gone, and the window is only a window.

choices.label: "You're sure?"
choices.res: "No." She smiles, crooked. "Goddesses are never sure. We just act like it."

low: A warm draft rattles the shutters. A voice, amused: "{lady}? Cute. You have taste, I'll give you that. Did she make that sound for you? I'd like to hear it again."
Every lantern in {house} flickers at once. Someone giggles. Nobody else hears it.
Sam finds a single small ember on his pillow, still warm, burning nothing. Under it, in a very elegant hand: "Busy week? I enjoyed the show."
mid: "{n} of them now." {goddess} is sitting on the end of the bar, invisible to everyone else, swinging her feet. "I'm not counting. I'm a goddess, I just know." Her toe traces a slow line down his leg.

{goddess} appears in Sam's room the night after he was with someone else. She doesn't say anything. She just sits there glowing at him, pointedly, her dress sliding lower by the minute, until he apologizes for something he can't name.
"{lady} again?" The voice is at his ear, warm and dry, and a hand he can't see settles at his belt. "I'll remember that. I'll want to compare."
high: Every candle in {house} gutters out at once. In the dark, {goddess}'s voice: "I brought you here. I could have picked anyone. Don't make me regret it." The candles relight themselves, one at a time.
{goddess} catches Sam in the hallway, pins him to the wall by the collar and kisses him hard enough to hurt, hands already inside his shirt. "So you remember who was first," she says, and is gone.
"How many, {sam}?" She isn't smiling. Her hand is on his chest, warm and possessive. "How many before you look up?"

remarkChoices.label: Tease her back
remarkChoices.res: Sam tells the empty air it looks lovely tonight. The air flushes gold. That shouldn't be possible.

remarkChoices.label: Reassure her
remarkChoices.res: "You were first. You'll always be first." A long pause. "...Fine," says the dark, mollified.

remarkChoices.label: Let it go
remarkChoices.res: Sam lets it go. Somewhere, a goddess sulks.

binding.title: Bound

image.comp: a goddess and a man embracing in bed, her skin glow fading, gold markings dimming and the ember-flame guttering, lantern-light dying around them, tears and a smile
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns going out one by one

binding.text:
This time the lanterns don't wait for him to wake. {goddess} is there before the dark is finished, and she doesn't say "again."

"{names} has lived it all now. Everything a life can carry. And so have I, watching you." She pulls him down with her. "I told you it was a whim. It wasn't. Years, Sam. Years of watching you be kind when nobody was looking: the stray cat you fed every single morning for two years, all the little things nobody ever thanked you for. I wanted you the whole time. I'm done watching."

She doesn't stop him this time. She holds on, and when he finishes inside her the light goes out of her like a breath let go: the glow under her skin, the gold markings, the little ember-flame, the warmth that never came from anywhere. Every lantern goes dark at once.

What's left is a woman with gold eyes, shaking, laughing, holding on to him.
binding.after:
"Oh," she says. "Oh, that's cold. Is it always this cold?" She burrows into him. "I'm yours now. All of me, the little that's left. I wanted you since before the truck, and I'd never have said so with the light still on. You'll have to build me back up, {sam}."

She has a tab of her own now. She'll do what she likes each week. You can tell her what you'd like; she might even listen.

indulge.label: Indulge them
indulge.desc: She seeks out the ladies who are most worked up or worn down and takes care of them herself: lust spent, mood and energy back.
indulge.report: {goddess} spent part of the week with {lady}. {lady} came back glowing.
feminine: {goddess} found {lady} restless and took her to bed. {lady} came back glowing and slept like a stone.
{goddess} drew {lady} a bath, got in with her, and didn't get out for hours.
futa: {goddess} chose to take {lady} as something more than a woman tonight. {lady} couldn't walk straight at breakfast and was smiling about it.
{goddess} let {lady} find out what a goddess can be when she feels like it. {lady} has not stopped blushing.

business.label: Business
business.desc: She works the floor of one house: patrons spend more, the house's name grows.
business.report: {goddess} worked the room at {house}. Patrons found themselves in a generous mood.

watch.label: Watch over them
watch.desc: She keeps an eye on the house with the most trouble and stops pushy clients before anyone else has to.
watch.saved: {goddess} stopped {n} pushy client(s) before anyone else had to. They left very politely and won't remember why.

tutelage.label: Tutelage
tutelage.desc: She takes the least practiced working lady as her pupil: job skill and a stat.
tutelage.report: {goddess} tutored {lady} in {skill}. She's a demanding teacher.

whim.label: Her whim
whim.desc: No guidance at all. She does what she feels like, a little more strongly than usual.

sam: {goddess} decided Sam was hers for a night and kept him up until dawn. He has never been so tired or so smug.
{goddess} didn't do what you asked. She dragged Sam to bed instead and wouldn't let go. (Sam's energy −)
lady: {goddess} took the new girl, {lady}, aside for a long, pointed conversation about who was here first. {lady} looks shaken, and oddly flattered.
{goddess} monopolized {lady} all week, half curious and half making a point. {lady} is exhausted.

image.comp: a goddess with faintly glowing bronze skin lying close against a man in bed at night, gold markings softly lit, a small ember-flame floating over them, content smile

low: {goddess} is cold more often than not now, and mortal-tired. She pulls Sam under the covers and against her, skin to skin, and for a while that's all.
"Warm me up," she says, and means it in every way.
mid: There's light coming back into her. Not much: a glow under her skin where he touches her, gold markings flickering awake along her collarbones and hips. She gasps at it every time, like she forgot.
high: {goddess} is almost herself again. The room is lantern-bright when she pulls him down, the candles leaning in. She could stop him now, if she wanted. She doesn't want.

inside: When he finishes inside her, light floods back into her skin, the gold markings flaring and the ember-flame spinning with delight. "There," she breathes, laughing. "That. More of that." A little of the warmth he lost all day comes back into him too.
Afterwards she lies with her ear against his chest, glowing, listening to the heartbeat she chose, and tells him exactly how pleased she is with his {act}. Smug, and radiant.
He finishes inside her and the room goes gold. {goddess} drags him closer by the hair and kisses him through it. "Good {sam}," she murmurs. "Good, good {sam}."
outside: He finishes, but not inside her, and {goddess} is pleased and a little sulky about it. "Considerate. Wasteful." No light comes back, but she traces circles on his chest anyway, and the flame hovers close.
"That was lovely, and I'm still cold." {goddess} nips his shoulder. "Next time, don't be so polite about the {act}."
She watches him finish with open appreciation, and then pouts, prettily, because the light stays out of her. "You know where it's supposed to go."
unhappy: {sam} didn't finish, and {goddess} is deeply put out. "You wasted my night," she pouts, and the candles dim to match her mood. "I wanted the {act} to end properly."
"Nothing? After all that?" {goddess} flops back on the pillow and glares at the ceiling. The ember-flame sulks in a corner. "You owe me. With interest."
{goddess} turns her back to him, arms crossed, skin dimming. "Wake me when you've remembered how it's done," she says, and does not sleep a wink.

stay.title: Whole again

image.comp: a radiant goddess fully glowing again, gold markings blazing, a bright ember-flame circling her shoulder, holding a man's hand on a rooftop at night, lanterns rising into the sky
image.setting: a rooftop at night, hundreds of paper lanterns floating up

stay.text:
It happens on an ordinary night. The light comes back all at once: the glow under her skin, the gold markings, the ember-flame, the warmth from nowhere. {goddess} is a goddess again, entirely.

The lanterns are waiting. She can feel them pulling.

She takes Sam's hand instead. "I could go," she says. "I could pick someone new and watch. That's what I'm for." Her fingers tighten. "I don't want to watch anymore. I'm staying."
stay.res: She stays, whole and divine and his. (Her story is complete. She keeps her full power.)

leave.title: Whole again

image.comp: a radiant goddess fully glowing again, gold markings blazing, an ember-flame at her shoulder, rising into a night sky full of lanterns, looking back over her shoulder
image.setting: a rooftop at night, hundreds of paper lanterns floating up

leave.text:
It happens on an ordinary night. The light comes back all at once: the glow under her skin, the gold markings, the ember-flame, the warmth from nowhere. {goddess} is a goddess again.

She looks at Sam for a long moment. "You gave it all back. Every bit of it." She touches his face. "But you never really asked me to stay, did you."

The lanterns rise, and she goes with them.
leave.res: She's gone. Somewhere, among the lanterns, she's picking someone new. (Her story is over.)

sam: {goddess} takes the lead, unhurried and entirely sure of what she wants, and Sam is very much along for the ride.
{goddess} touches him freely, teasing and possessive, the candles in the room leaning in to watch.
feminine: {goddess} spent the evening with {lady}, who has not stopped smiling.
{lady} and {goddess} disappeared into the goddess's candle-lit room for a long while.
futa: {goddess} took a form with something extra for {lady}, and was in no hurry at all.
{lady} learned what a goddess does with a body she can change at will. She is still pink.

sam: {goddess} straddles his back with warm oil she conjured from nowhere and works the day out of his shoulders, humming. Every so often her hands wander lower than anatomy strictly requires.
"Hold still, you're all knots." Her thumbs find every one, her breath warm on his neck, the little ember-flame drifting down to light the room.
feminine: {lady} spent the evening working oil into {goddess}'s shoulders and back while the goddess purred and issued notes. Neither of them looked at the clock.
{goddess} lay back and let {lady}'s hands do as they pleased; the gold markings on her skin glowed warmer with every pass.
futa: {goddess} wore a rather more generous form that night and let {lady} knead the tension out of her. It turned out not all of it was in her shoulders.
{lady} oiled the goddess down, shoulders to hips, and found the form {goddess} had picked eager to be appreciated.

sam: She kisses him like she has all the time in the world, slow, then not slow, until the candles lean toward them.
{goddess} pins him against the wall by his shirt and kisses him breathless, her gold markings flaring where his hands land on her hips.
feminine: {goddess} kissed {lady} against the lamp-lit doorway until {lady} forgot what she'd come for.
{lady} and {goddess} traded slow kisses over a shared candle; the flame leaned toward them, scandalized.
futa: {goddess} kissed {lady} slowly, a hand at her waist and a clearly interested body pressed close. {lady} forgot the question she'd come to ask.
{lady} was kissed against the bookshelves by a goddess in an unmistakably generous mood.

sam: She lies face down across the bed, dress pooled at her waist. "Your turn, Sam. Take your time. I'll tell you if you're doing it wrong." She does, smiling into the pillow, often.
"Oil. Hands. Lower," says {goddess}, directing him like a conductor, her skin warming under his palms until it glows.
feminine: {goddess} oiled {lady} from neck to ankle with unhurried hands, narrating compliments as she went. {lady} melted.
{goddess} turned {lady} into a puddle with her hands alone, and won't say how long it took.
futa: {goddess} worked {lady} over with warm oil and warmer hands, and was plainly enjoying the effect she was having. {lady} did not complain.
{lady} lay back under {goddess}'s hands and the heat of a body pressed along her side. It was not strictly a massage by the end.

sam: {goddess} guides his hand with her own, showing him exactly the pace she wants, eyes half-closed. "There. Good student."
She leans back against him, sets his fingers where she wants them and sighs, the markings at her hips brightening with each breath.
feminine: {goddess} slipped a hand where {lady} needed it most and kept her there, trembling, until she asked politely.
{lady} found out how patient a goddess's fingers can be. She is still catching her breath.
futa: {goddess} kept {lady} pinned against her with one arm and took her time with the other. {lady} stopped trying to be quiet.
{lady} was held close by a goddess with something extra to press against her, and a very clever hand. It was a lot.

sam: Her hand is warm and unhurried and very sure; she watches his face the whole time, enjoying every change in it.
"Eyes on me," says {goddess}, and keeps him on the edge, patient and smug, until he is saying her name.
feminine: {lady} followed {goddess}'s murmured directions with her hand and was rewarded with a glow bright enough to read by.
{goddess} guided {lady}'s hand and sighed her approval; the ember-flame bobbed happily overhead.
futa: {lady} took {goddess} in her hand at the goddess's soft command, and got to watch a deity lose her composure.
{goddess} let {lady} explore, murmuring encouragement, her free hand tangled in {lady}'s hair.

sam: {goddess} arches into his hands, guiding his mouth where she wants it. "Don't rush. I picked you for your patience."
She laughs, low and pleased, as he takes his time with her, the ember-flame bobbing close as if to see.
feminine: {goddess} took her time with {lady}'s chest, attentive and a bit smug, until {lady} was clutching the sheets.
{lady} gasped as {goddess}'s warm mouth and hands made a long, thorough study of her.
futa: {goddess} lavished {lady}'s chest with attention while pressing close in a way that made her intentions clear. {lady} did not argue.
{lady} was held in a goddess's lap and thoroughly adored, a hard-to-ignore warmth against her thigh the whole time.

sam: She settles back on the pillows like a queen receiving a petitioner, one hand in his hair. "Slowly. I'll tell you when to stop. I won't."
{goddess} lets out a sound that sets every lantern in the room swaying, her hand firm on the back of his head.
feminine: {goddess} knelt between {lady}'s knees like a petitioner and took the long way round. {lady} won't describe it.
{lady} lost track of time under {goddess}'s patient, devoted attention. Every candle in the room burned a little brighter.
futa: {goddess} spent the night lavishing {lady} with devoted attention before taking things further. {lady} has asked for more candles, for atmosphere.
{lady} was worshipped, thoroughly, by a goddess who clearly enjoyed the work. She is going to need a day.

sam: She kneels, looks up at him with gold eyes and the beginning of a grin, and takes her time, thoroughly enjoying how undone he gets.
"I've been wanting to do this," says {goddess}, and then doesn't say anything else for a good while.
feminine: {lady} knelt for {goddess}, who lay back among the cushions, glowing and issuing soft, imperious encouragement.
{goddess} let {lady} worship her properly, one hand in her hair, until the lanterns swayed.
futa: {lady} knelt for {goddess} and did her best by the goddess's generous new form, to a chorus of approving noises and flaring candles.
{goddess} let {lady} take her time, a hand stroking her hair and murmuring that she was doing beautifully.

sam: {goddess} presses close, warm and soft, and uses everything she has to make him forget his own name, watching his face the entire time.
She tucks him against her and teases, slow, sure, delighted, every flicker of his expression logged and appreciated.
feminine: {lady} lavished {goddess}'s chest with attention, and the goddess rewarded her with a long, warm sigh and brightening skin.
{goddess} arched into {lady}'s hands and mouth, smiling like a cat with a very large bowl of cream.
futa: {lady} paid devoted attention to the goddess's chest while the rest of her became very obviously interested. {lady} noticed. {goddess} didn't care.
{goddess} guided {lady}'s mouth and hands with a murmur or two, and the markings on her skin glowed in encouragement.

sam: She pulls him over her, legs around his waist, hands in his hair, and the whole room glows with her. "Look at me. Stay with me. Not too far, Sam."
{goddess} holds his gaze through all of it, her skin brightening with every breath, one hand pressed to his chest to set the pace. Hers.
futa: {goddess} laid {lady} back among the pillows in a very generous form and took things slow. {lady} saw lanterns.
{lady} was held down, kissed, and thoroughly made love to by a goddess who took her time. The candles didn't survive it.

sam: She takes charge, naturally, setting a rhythm that makes the candles flare and gutter in time, a hand flat on his chest. "Mine, Sam. Hold still and let me."
{goddess} rides him in lantern-light, head back, markings blazing, the ember-flame circling above them like a spectator.
futa: {goddess} lay back and let {lady} take charge, which {lady} did with considerable and gratifying enthusiasm.
{lady} climbed onto a smug, glowing goddess and set the pace herself. {goddess} supervised, approvingly.

sam: She looks back over her shoulder, gold eyes bright, and sets the pace herself, pushing back against him with a laugh. "Don't be shy now."
{goddess} grips the bedframe, hair spilling like ink and embers down her back, and tells him exactly how much she approves.
futa: {goddess} took {lady} from behind, one hand firm at her hip, in a form she'd chosen on purpose. {lady} gripped the headboard and thanked her.
{lady} found herself bent over the arm of a chair with a goddess behind her, murmuring praise into her hair.
